note: Test questions for the per-expert knowledge bases, written blind on 15.10.2026 before any retrieval run and without reading any collected source (data/knowledge/*/ and work/knowledge/ were not opened); only topics.json and the scenario goals were read. 24 questions per expert, every topic at least 3 times, 8 fr / 8 de / 8 it per expert. canton = jurisdiction of the official source expected to answer (CH when federal); cantonal questions are balanced over VD, ZH, BE, GE, TI within each expert. No question states its answer.

questions.q: J'habite à Lausanne et je n'arriverai pas à remplir ma déclaration d'impôt à temps. Jusqu'à quand dois-je la rendre et comment demander un délai ?
